name: Date Maki
source:
A judge who knows everything about the island of Saiban. She is in sole charge of the trial of Jingasa Shii.
Her trademark is her large hat and judge's hammer, which do not match her small stature.
She is a perfect superhero, a kind of angel, who energetically keeps order on the island.
